mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term coefficient is non-significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes, SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization that supports earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 450.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 450.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable/rising, or interaction term coefficient is non-significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In slow consumer spending regimes (RSAFS growth < 0.5% monthly), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals broader demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In slow consumer spending regimes, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST declines, or interaction term coefficient is non-significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.
